迈克·马力甘和他的蒸汽挖土机
[美]维吉尼亚·李·伯顿◎著绘 艾柯◎译

和他的蒸汽挖土机

[P4] 迈克·马力甘有一辆红色的蒸汽挖土机，
这辆漂亮的挖土机名叫玛丽安。
迈克·马力甘为玛丽安感到自豪，
他常常说，一百个工人一个星期挖出来的土，
玛丽安一天就能挖完，
不过，他也不确定这是不是真的。

[P5] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
在一起挖土，
一年又一年。
迈克·马力甘把玛丽安
照顾得很好。
玛丽安总像新的一样。
迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
还有同伴们，
一起挖好了大运河，
大船可以在上面航行。

[P6] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
还有同伴们，
一起挖开了高山，
火车可以穿山而过。

[P7] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
还有同伴们，
一起挖平了丘陵，
弯路变得笔直。
在上面建起长长的高速公路，
汽车可以平稳驶过。

[P8] 在上面建起停机坪，
让飞机起飞降落。

是迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
还有同伴们，
一起铲平地面、
填平低洼。

在上面建起停机坪，
让飞机起飞降落。

[P9] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
还有同伴们，
挖出一个又一个深坑，
为城市的摩天大楼打下地基。
如果人们停下脚步看他们干活，
迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
会挖得更快、更好。
看的人越多，
他们就挖得越快、越好。
有时候甚至要37辆大卡车
不停地工作，
才能运走他们挖出来的土。

[P10] 不久，
新型的汽油挖土机、
新型的电动挖土机、
新型的柴油挖土机出现了，
没人再用蒸汽挖土机干活了。
迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
感到非常难过。

[P11] 迈克把玛丽安
照顾得那么好，
一百个工人一星期挖的土，
玛丽安一天就能挖完。
至少迈克是这么想的，
虽然他也不太确定。
可是，不管在哪儿，
新型的汽油挖土机、
新型的电动挖土机、
新型的柴油挖土机，
都会把他们的工作抢走，
没有人再需要迈克·马力甘和玛丽安。
直到有一天，迈克·马力甘在报纸上读到一条消息：
砰砰镇要建一座新的镇中心办公楼。
“我们去给这座办公楼挖地基吧。”迈克对玛丽安说。
于是，他们出发了。
其他蒸汽挖土机都被当做废品卖了，
或者丢弃在破旧的砂砾坑里，慢慢生锈、散架。
迈克爱玛丽安，他不想这样对待她。

[P12] 他们跨过运河、
穿过铁路、
路过机场、
开上高速公路，
离开了大城市——
那里没有人再需要他们。
他们去往乡村。
他们慢慢前行。
上山、下山，
终于来到了
砰砰镇。

[P13] 到了那儿他们发现：
镇上的委员们正在决定谁来为新的办公楼挖地基。
迈克·马力甘找到委员之一亨利·丝万普，
“我听说，你们要建镇中心办公楼，
玛丽安和我一天就能把地基挖好。”
“怎么可能！”亨利·丝万普说，“一天就能挖好？
新办公楼的地基至少要一百个工人挖一周。”
“没错，”迈克回答，“可是一百个工人一星期挖的土，
玛丽安一天就能挖完。”
虽然他也不确定是不是真的能做到。
迈克接着说：
“如果我们做不到，你不用付钱。”
亨利·丝万普想：这是一个好办法，
可以免费把部分地基挖好。
所以他坏笑着，
把挖地基的工作给了
迈克·马力甘和玛丽安。

[P14] 第二天一大早，
太阳刚刚升起，
他们就开始挖土了。
不一会儿，一个小男孩跑过来问：
“你们能在太阳落山前挖好吗？”
“如果你留在这儿看我们挖，就一定能。”
迈克回答，“有人看我们干活时，
我们总能干得又快又好。”
于是小男孩留了下来。

[P15] 接着麦基卡迪夫人、
亨利·丝万普、
镇警官，
都过来看挖得怎么样了。
他们也留了下来。

迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
挖得更快、更好了。

[P16] 这让小男孩想到一个主意，
他跑去告诉正在送信的邮差，
骑自行车的报童，
驾着马车的送奶工，
赶着回家的医生，
刚好来到镇上的农夫一家，
所有人都停住脚步，过来观看。
这让迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
挖得更快了，也更好了。
他们挖好了第一个角，平整又方正……
而太阳越升越高。

[P17] 哐啷！哐啷！哐啷！
消防队来了。
他们看见烟尘滚滚，以为着火了。
小男孩对他们说：
“你们为什么不留下来看看呢？”
于是，砰砰镇的消防队也留下来看迈克·马力甘和玛丽安挖土。
街对面的学校里，
孩子们听到消防车的声音，也没心思上课了。
老师让大家课间休息，
整个学校的人都跑来看。
这让迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
挖得更快更好了。
他们完成了第二个角，平整又方正，
而太阳已经升到了头顶。

[P18] 他们挖好了第三个角……平整又方正。

镇上接电话的姑娘，
打电话给隔壁的梆梆镇、咣咣镇、
轰轰镇和隆隆镇，
告诉他们砰砰镇正在发生的事儿。
所有人都跑过来看——
迈克·马力甘和他的蒸汽挖土机，
能不能在一天内挖好地基。
来的人越多，迈克·马力甘和玛丽安就挖得越快。
他们必须抓紧时间。
地基才挖了一半，
而太阳已经开始往下落。

[P19] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
从来没挖得这么快、这么好。
因为从来没有这么多人看他们干活，
太阳也没落得这么快。
“快点，迈克·马力甘！
快呀！快呀！
小男孩大叫，
“时间不多了！
只见到处尘土飞扬，
烟雾和蒸汽“噗噗”四散，
人们什么都看不见。
但是，听啊……
乒！乓！梆！砰！
越来越响，
越来越快！

[P20] 四个角，平整方正；
四面墙，规整笔直，
迈克·马力甘和玛丽安就在下面，
这时太阳正好落山。
“万岁！”人群欢呼，“迈克·马力甘和他的蒸汽挖土机万岁！
他们只用一天就挖好了地基。”
突然，一切都安静下来，
灰尘慢慢落下，
烟雾和蒸汽渐渐散开——
地基挖好了！

[P21] 突然，小男孩问：
“他们怎么出来呢？”
“是啊，”麦基卡迪夫人问亨利·丝万普，
“他怎么把蒸汽挖土机弄出来？”
亨利·丝万普坏笑着，
没有回答。
大家也纷纷议论：
“他们怎么出来呢？”
“喂！迈克·马力甘！
你怎么把你的
蒸汽挖土机弄出来？”
迈克·马力甘看看四周——
四面墙平平整整，
四个角方方正正，
然后他回答：
“我们挖得太快了，
完全忘了要留一条出去的路。”
迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
从来没遇到过这种事，
他们也不知道该怎么办。

[P22] 砰砰镇也从来没有
发生过这样的事儿。
大家开始讨论，
每个人都认为
自己的主意是最棒的。
他们争论来，争论去，
直到筋疲力尽，
还是没有人知道，
怎么把迈克·马力甘和玛丽安
从他们挖的大坑里弄出来。
亨利·丝万普说道：
“因为玛丽安没法出来，
所以这份工作不算完成，
迈克·马力甘也得不到报酬。”
说完，他又坏笑起来。
这时，一直没说话的小男孩
又想出了一个好主意。
他说：“为什么不把玛丽安留在原地，
就在上面盖镇中心办公楼？
玛丽安可以作办公楼的锅炉★，
迈克·马力甘可以当她的管理员。
这样你们就不用买新锅炉了，
省下的钱可以付给迈克·马力甘，
因为他们只用了一天时间
就挖好了地基。”
★感谢迪克·波肯布什想出这个好主意。

[P23] “为什么不呢？”亨利·丝万普笑了，
但他的笑不再是坏笑。
“为什么不呢？”麦基卡迪夫人说。
“为什么不呢？”镇警官说。
“为什么不呢？”所有人都这么说。
于是他们找来一把梯子
爬下去问迈克·马力甘和玛丽安。
“为什么不呢？”迈克·马力甘回答。
事情就这么决定了，
大家都很高兴。

[P24] 每天，小男孩都来看迈克·马力甘和玛丽安，
麦基卡迪夫人会带来美味的、热腾腾的苹果派，
而亨利·丝万普
经常呆在镇中心办公楼的地下室，
听迈克·马力甘讲故事。
他的笑容已经不再是坏笑了。
冬天来临前，
新的镇中心办公楼建好了，
迈克·马力甘和玛丽安就住在下面。

[P25] 现在如果你去砰砰镇，
一定要去镇中心办公楼的地下室。
那里有迈克·马力甘和玛丽安——
迈克在他的摇椅上抽着烟斗，
玛丽安就在他旁边，
把镇中心办公楼的每一个房间
都烧得暖暖和和。

[P4] Mike Mulligan had a red steam shovel,
this beautiful shovel was named Mary Anne.
Mike Mulligan was proud of Mary Anne,
he often said, the amount of earth dug up by a hundred workers in a week,
Mary Anne could dig up in one day,
but he wasn't sure if it was true.

[P5] Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
worked together digging,
year after year.
Mike Mulligan took good care of Mary Anne.
Mary Anne always looked brand new.
Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
and their companions,
dug the big canal together,
so big ships could sail on it.

[P6] Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne,
along with their companions,
together dug through the mountain,
so trains could pass through it.

[P7] Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne,
along with their companions,
flattened the hills together,
and the winding roads became straight.
On top, a long highway was built,
where cars could drive smoothly.

[P8] On top, they built an airstrip,
for planes to take off and land.

It was Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne,
and their companions,
working together to level the ground,
and fill in the low spots.

On top, they built an airstrip,
for planes to take off and land.

[P9] Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
along with their companions,
excavated one deep pit after another,
laying the foundation for the city's skyscrapers.
If people stopped to watch them work,
Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
would dig faster and better.
The more people who watched,
the faster and better they would dig.
Sometimes it took as many as 37 big trucks
working nonstop
to haul away the dirt they dug out.

[P10] Soon,
new gasoline excavators,
new electric excavators,
new diesel excavators appeared,
and no one used steam shovels anymore.
Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
felt very sad.

[P11] Mike took such good care of Marian,
that the amount of dirt one hundred workers could dig in a week,
Marian could dig up in a day.
At least that's what Mike thought,
though he wasn't quite sure.
But wherever they went,
new gasoline excavators,
new electric excavators,
new diesel excavators,
would steal their jobs,
and no one would need Mike Mulligan and Marian anymore.
Then one day, Mike Mulligan read a message in the newspaper:
"Pip Town is going to build a new town center office building."
"Let's go dig the foundation for this office building," Mike said to Marian.
So they set off.
Other steam excavators were sold as scrap,
or abandoned in old gravel pits, slowly rusting and falling apart.
Mike loved Marian, and he didn't want to treat her that way.

[P12] They crossed the canal,
went through the railway,
passed by the airport,
drove onto the highway,
and left the big city——
where no one needed them anymore.
They headed for the countryside.
They moved slowly.
Up hills, down hills,
they finally arrived at
Popperville.

[P13] When they arrived, they found:
The town council was deciding who would dig the foundation for the new office building.
Mike Mulligan found one of the council members, Henry S. Smith,
"I hear you're building a town center office building,
Mary Anne and I can dig the foundation in one day."
"How is that possible!" Henry S. Smith said, "One day? The foundation for the new office building would take at least a hundred workers a week."
"That's right," Mike replied, "But the amount of dirt a hundred workers dig in a week,
Mary Anne can dig in one day."
Although he wasn't sure if they could really do it.
Mike continued:
"If we don't do it, you don't have to pay."
Henry S. Smith thought: This is a good idea,
we can get part of the foundation dug for free.
So he grinned mischievously,
and gave the job of digging the foundation to
Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne.

[P14] The next morning, early,
the sun had just risen,
and they began digging.
Soon, a little boy ran over and asked:
"Can you finish digging before the sun sets?"
"If you stay here and watch us dig, you certainly can."
Mike replied, "When someone watches us work,
we always manage to do it quickly and well."
So the little boy stayed.

[P15] Then Mrs. Mackey, Henry Swamp, and the town policeman
all came to see how the digging was going.
They stayed too.

Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
were digging faster and better.

[P16] This gave the little boy an idea.
He ran to tell the mailman delivering letters,
the newsboy riding his bicycle,
the milkman driving his horse-drawn cart,
the doctor hurrying home,
and the farmer's family who had just arrived in town.
Everyone stopped and came to watch.
This made Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne dig faster and better.
They finished the first corner, neat and square...
and the sun rose higher and higher.

[P17] Clang! Clang! Clang!
The fire department arrived.
They saw smoke and dust rolling, and thought there was a fire.
The little boy said to them:
"Why don't you stay and watch?"
So, the fire department of Bumpkinville stayed to watch Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne dig.
Across the street, in the school,
the children heard the sound of the fire engine and couldn't focus on their lessons.
The teacher let everyone have a break,
and everyone in the school ran over to watch.
This made Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
dig faster and better.
They completed the second corner, neat and square,
and the sun had already risen to the top of the sky.

[P18] They had dug the third corner... neat and square.

The girl who answered the phone in town
called the neighboring towns of Bang-Bang, Clang-Clang,
Hoo-Hoo, and Thump-Thump,
telling them what was happening in Pong-Pong Town.
Everyone ran over to see—
Mike Mulligan and his steam shovel,
could they dig the foundation in one day?
The more people who came, the faster Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne dug.
They had to hurry.
The foundation was only half dug,
and the sun was already beginning to set.

[P19] Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
had never dug so fast, so well.
Because never before had so many people watched them work,
and the sun had never set so fast.
"Hurry, Mike Mulligan!
Hurry! Hurry!"
the little boy shouted,
"There's not much time left!"
Dust flew everywhere,
smoke and steam puffed out,
and people couldn't see a thing.
But listen...
Ping! Bang! Thump! Pow!
Loud and louder,
faster and faster!

[P20] Four corners, neat and square;
Four walls, straight and even,
Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne are down below,
Just as the sun is setting.
"Hooray!" the crowd cheered, "Hooray for Mike Mulligan and his steam shovel!
They dug the foundation in just one day!"
Suddenly, everything grew quiet,
Dust slowly settled,
Smoke and steam gradually dispersed—
The foundation was dug!

[P21] Suddenly, the little boy asked:
"How will they get out?"
"Yes," Mrs. McGillicuddy asked Henry Swamp,
"How will he get his steam shovel out?"
Henry Swamp grinned mischievously,
but said nothing.
Everyone began to discuss:
"How will they get out?"
"Hey! Mike Mulligan!
How will you get your
steam shovel out?"
Mike Mulligan looked around—
the four walls were smooth and even,
the four corners were square and neat,
then he answered:
"We dug too fast,
and completely forgot to leave a way out."
Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
had never encountered such a thing before,
and they didn't know what to do.

[P22] Pengpeng Town had never had anything like this happen before.
Everyone started discussing.
Each person thought their idea was the best.
They argued and argued,
until they were exhausted,
yet no one knew
how to get Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne
out of the big hole they had dug.
Henry Swamp said:
"Because Mary Anne can't get out,
this job isn't finished,
and Mike Mulligan won't get paid."
Then he laughed evilly.
At this moment, the boy who had been silent
thought of another good idea.
He said, "Why not leave Mary Anne right where she is,
and build the town's central office building on top?
Mary Anne could be the boiler for the office building★,
and Mike Mulligan could be her manager.
That way, you wouldn't need to buy a new boiler,
and the money saved could be paid to Mike Mulligan,
because they finished the foundation in just one day."
★ Thank you, Dick Pokinbush, for thinking of this great idea.

[P23] "Why not?" Henry Swamp smiled,
but his smile was no longer a sneer.
"Why not?" Mrs. Mackey said.
"Why not?" the town policeman said.
"Why not?" everyone said.
So they brought a ladder
and climbed down to ask Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne.
"Why not?" Mike Mulligan answered.
The matter was decided,
and everyone was very happy.

[P24] Every day, the little boy came to see Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne,
Mrs. McGee would bring delicious, steaming hot apple pie,
and Henry Sump
often stayed in the basement of the town hall,
listening to Mike Mulligan tell stories.
His smile was no longer a sneer.
Before winter came,
the new town hall was built,
and Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne lived underneath.

[P25] Now, if you go to Pingsheng Town,
be sure to visit the basement of the town center office building.
There you'll find Mike Mulligan and Mary Anne—
Mike sitting in his rocking chair, smoking his pipe,
Mary Anne right beside him,
keeping every room in the town center office building warm and cozy.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，展示了书名《迈克·马力甘和他的蒸汽挖土机》、作者维吉尼亚·李·伯顿及译者艾柯的信息，画面中央是一台巨大的蒸汽挖土机，驾驶舱内有一个人挥手。
[P2] 本页为绘本封面，展示了书名《迈克·马力甘和他的蒸汽挖土机》、作者维吉尼亚·李·伯顿及译者艾柯的信息，画面中央是一台巨大的蒸汽挖土机，驾驶舱内有一个人挥手。
[P3] 本页以图解形式介绍了蒸汽挖土机的各个部件名称及其操作功能，包括挖掘、起重和转动三种基本动作，并标注了驾驶员迈克·马力甘。
[P4] 本页介绍了主人公迈克·马力甘和他的红色蒸汽挖土机玛丽安，描述了他对机器的自豪以及对玛丽安强大挖掘能力的自信，尽管他也不确定这是否属实。
[P5] 本页通过两幅插图和文字，讲述了迈克·马力甘和玛丽安年复一年地一起挖土，迈克精心照料玛丽安，使其始终保持如新；他们还与同伴们共同挖通了一条大运河，让大船得以航行。
[P6] 迈克·马力甘、玛丽安和同伴们一起挖开了高山，为火车修建了穿山而过的隧道。
[P7] 迈克·马力甘、玛丽安和同伴们一起挖平了丘陵，使弯路变直，并在上面修建了高速公路，方便汽车通行。
[P8] 迈克·马力甘、玛丽安和同伴们一起铲平地面、填平低洼，为飞机建造了停机坪。
[P9] 迈克·马力甘、玛丽安和同伴们在城市中挖掘深坑，为摩天大楼打地基，围观的人越多，他们挖得越快越好，有时需要37辆大卡车才能运走挖出的土。
[P10] 本页描述了新型挖土机的出现导致蒸汽挖土机被淘汰，迈克·马力甘和玛丽安因此感到非常难过。
[P11] 本页描述了新型挖土机取代蒸汽挖土机后，迈克·马力甘和玛丽安面临失业，其他蒸汽挖土机被废弃或卖掉。迈克在报纸上看到砰砰镇要建新办公楼的消息，决定带玛丽安去挖地基，于是他们出发了。
[P12] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安离开大城市，穿过运河、铁路、机场和高速公路，前往乡村，最终抵达了砰砰镇。
[P13] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安抵达砰砰镇，向镇委员会申请为新办公楼挖地基，承诺一天完成，若失败则不收费，委员会最终同意将工作交给他们。
[P14] 第二天一大早，迈克·马力甘和玛丽安开始为砰砰镇的新办公楼挖地基，一个小男孩跑来询问能否在太阳落山前完成，迈克告诉他只要有人观看，他们就能又快又好地完成，于是小男孩留下来观看。
[P15] 麦基卡迪夫人、亨利·丝万普和镇警官前来观看挖土进度并留下观看，迈克·马力甘和玛丽安因此挖得更快更好了。
[P16] 小男孩号召镇上的人们前来观看迈克·马力甘和玛丽安挖地基，他们的工作因此变得更高效，顺利完成了第一个角落。
[P17] 消防队和学校的孩子们被挖土机的动静吸引，纷纷前来观看迈克·马力甘和玛丽安挖地基，他们的工作因此变得更加高效，顺利完成了第二个角落。
[P18] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安在砰砰镇挖地基，吸引了周边城镇的人们前来观看，挖土进度加快，但太阳已开始下落，地基只完成一半。
[P19] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安在众人围观下加快速度挖地基，尘土和烟雾弥漫，但机器声越来越响、越来越快，时间紧迫。
[P20] 迈克·马力甘和玛丽安在众人围观下成功挖好了地基，太阳正好落山，人群欢呼庆祝他们的成就。
[P21] 在众人围观下，迈克·马力甘和玛丽安成功挖好地基，但因挖得太快而忘了留出通道，导致他们和蒸汽挖土机被困在地基内，不知如何脱身。
[P22] 众人因迈克·马力甘和玛丽安被困在地基中而争论不休，无法想出解决办法，最终由一直沉默的小男孩提出将玛丽安留在原地作为办公楼锅炉的主意，解决了困境。
[P23] 众人对将玛丽安留在地基内作为锅炉的提议表示赞同，纷纷爬下梯子询问迈克·马力甘，他欣然同意，事情就此决定，大家都很高兴。
[P24] 在众人帮助下，新的镇中心办公楼建成，迈克·马力甘和玛丽安住在楼下的地下室，小男孩、麦基卡迪夫人和亨利·丝万普等人也常来探望或陪伴他们。
[P25] 本页描述了迈克·马力甘和玛丽安在镇中心办公楼地下室的温馨生活场景，迈克在摇椅上抽烟斗，玛丽安作为锅炉为整栋楼供暖，画面中还有人们上下楼梯，环境温暖舒适。
[P26] 画面描绘了一个宁静的乡村景象：绿色的山坡上点缀着几座房屋和教堂，一条蜿蜒的小路穿过田野，一辆蒸汽挖土机正冒着黑烟行驶在小路上，背景是明亮的太阳和飞翔的鸟儿，整体氛围温暖而祥和。
